{
  "type_map": {
    "FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "IPV4_SRC_ADDR": "nominal",
    "L4_SRC_PORT": "integer",
    "IPV4_DST_ADDR": "nominal",
    "L4_DST_PORT": "integer",
    "PROTOCOL": "integer",
    "L7_PROTO": "integer",
    "IN_BYTES": "integer",
    "IN_PKTS": "integer",
    "OUT_BYTES": "integer",
    "OUT_PKTS": "integer",
    "TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS": "integer",
    "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS": "integer",
    "DURATION_IN": "integer",
    "DURATION_OUT": "integer",
    "MIN_TTL": "integer",
    "MAX_TTL": "integer",
    "LONGEST_FLOW_PKT": "integer",
    "SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT": "integer",
    "MIN_IP_PKT_LEN": "integer",
    "MAX_IP_PKT_LEN": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_IN_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_IN_PKTS": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_BYTES": "integer",
    "RETRANSMITTED_OUT_PKTS": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_UP_TO_128_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_128_TO_256_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_256_TO_512_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_512_TO_1024_BYTES": "integer",
    "NUM_PKTS_1024_TO_1514_BYTES": "integer",
    "TCP_WIN_MAX_IN": "integer",
    "TCP_WIN_MAX_OUT": "integer",
    "ICMP_TYPE": "integer",
    "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE": "integer",
    "DNS_QUERY_ID": "integer",
    "DNS_QUERY_TYPE": "integer",
    "DNS_TTL_ANSWER": "integer",
    "FTP_COMMAND_RET_CODE": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_MIN": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_MAX": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_AVG": "integer",
    "SRC_TO_DST_IAT_STDDEV": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_MIN": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_MAX": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_AVG": "integer",
    "DST_TO_SRC_IAT_STDDEV": "integer"
  },
  "constraints": [
    {
      "id": "R1",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] == df['FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS'] - df['FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS']"
      ],
      "features": ["FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "FLOW_END_MILLISECONDS", "FLOW_START_MILLISECONDS"],
      "rationale": "Flow duration is defined as the difference between flow end and start timestamps."
    },
    {
      "id": "R2",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, np.isclose(df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'], df['IN_BYTES'] / (df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_IN'] > 0, np.isclose(df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'], df['IN_BYTES'] / (df['DURATION_IN'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES", "IN_BYTES", "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "DURATION_IN"],
      "rationale": "Src to dst bytes per second is computed from incoming bytes divided by either total flow duration or directional duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R3",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, np.isclose(df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'], df['OUT_BYTES'] / (df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_OUT'] > 0, np.isclose(df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'], df['OUT_BYTES'] / (df['DURATION_OUT'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES", "OUT_BYTES", "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "DURATION_OUT"],
      "rationale": "Dst to src bytes per second is computed from outgoing bytes divided by either total flow duration or directional duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R4",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], df['SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES'] * 8, rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, np.isclose(df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], (df['IN_BYTES'] * 8) / (df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_IN'] > 0, np.isclose(df['SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], (df['IN_BYTES'] * 8) / (df['DURATION_IN'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["SRC_TO_DST_AVG_THROUGHPUT", "SRC_TO_DST_SECOND_BYTES", "IN_BYTES", "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "DURATION_IN"],
      "rationale": "Src to dst average throughput in bps is either 8 times the bytes per second rate or directly computed from bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R5",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "np.isclose(df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], df['DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES'] * 8, rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0)",
        "np.where(df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] > 0, np.isclose(df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 8) / (df['FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)",
        "np.where(df['DURATION_OUT'] > 0, np.isclose(df['DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT'], (df['OUT_BYTES'] * 8) / (df['DURATION_OUT'] / 1000), rtol=1e-3, atol=1.0), True)"
      ],
      "features": ["DST_TO_SRC_AVG_THROUGHPUT", "DST_TO_SRC_SECOND_BYTES", "OUT_BYTES", "FLOW_DURATION_MILLISECONDS", "DURATION_OUT"],
      "rationale": "Dst to src average throughput in bps is either 8 times the bytes per second rate or directly computed from bytes and duration."
    },
    {
      "id": "R6",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['ICMP_TYPE'] // 256 == df['ICMP_IPV4_TYPE']"
      ],
      "features": ["ICMP_TYPE", "ICMP_IPV4_TYPE"],
      "rationale": "ICMP_TYPE is defined as ICMP type multiplied by 256 plus code, so integer division by 256 yields the type."
    },
    {
      "id": "R7",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "(df['LONGEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MAX_IP_PKT_LEN']) & (df['SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT'] == df['MIN_IP_PKT_LEN'])"
      ],
      "features": ["LONGEST_FLOW_PKT", "MAX_IP_PKT_LEN", "SHORTEST_FLOW_PKT", "MIN_IP_PKT_LEN"],
      "rationale": "Longest and shortest packet lengths are identical to the maximum and minimum IP packet lengths observed."
    },
    {
      "id": "R8",
      "category": "definition",
      "alternatives": [
        "df['TCP_FLAGS'] == (df['CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS'] | df['SERVER_TCP_FLAGS'])"
      ],
      "features": ["TCP_FLAGS", "CLIENT_TCP_FLAGS", "SERVER_TCP_FLAGS"],
      "rationale": "Cumulative TCP flags for the whole flow are the bitwise OR of client and server flags."
    }
  ]
}
